items.title: Lawrence Duhé Interview, 1957-06-09
items.q: Well, I went to his place too the other day.

ctx.x: Well, I went to his place too the other day. He wrote, he comported it.

He was playing with Mr. Brower, you know. That's right, yeah. He plays a clarinet right now, man. He's a clarinet. Still can play all right. Maybe not quite like he used to, but he still gets around all right.
